project.name: Porch Light
project.summary: A retrospective Manatee County care-facility outreach workbench with 18 deterministically ranked records, two refusals, sourced contacts and inspectable evidence. Separate national weather context does not establish national facility ranking or current facility conditions.

builders.name: Joe Gaither
builders.role: owner: decides, reviews and merges; agents write the code

zetaris.how: Seven independently audited statements join separate CMS, Census, SVI and emPOWER relations in Zetaris SQL, with SQL-measured match counts. All source relations currently share one read-only PostGIS datasource; spatial predicates stay in PostGIS. The UI reads the audited export. A Unified Semantic Layer and multiple physical live systems are not claimed.
data_sources: porchlight_postgis: read-only PostgreSQL/PostGIS source containing captured public records and pre-joined exports

meterless.how: Two Meterless uses. Runtime: one stored Nemotron execution used the meterless/deep route through the local Nightshift gateway with thinking disabled; its response produced three drafts. Engine: a fresh Scout Intent implementation (engines/scout_intent.py) gates the live call-script path. Each operator request is classified against a versioned intent registry, bound to its facility parameter, passed through injection, policy, scope, sensitivity and rate-limit guards, routed only when the Meterless Runtime token exists, and issued an HMAC-SHA256 signed execution contract with a 5 minute TTL. The grounded-draft executor refuses unsigned, tampered, expired or out-of-scope contracts before any provider call or budget reservation; the sole retry is a replan on the same trace. Honest limits: Stage 1 deterministic scoring only (no local embedding stage), the signing key is a local integrity secret, and batch explanation drafts are not yet contract-gated. H-MEM, World Model, Markovian and local model execution are not implemented claims.

cursor.how: Cursor cloud agents wrote Storm Watch v2 and the Storm Glass Desk design, and the national county and alert web wiring. Both pull requests are merged. Devin wrote the data, engines, and most of the web. Joe directed the work. No token count or spend is recorded.

nvidia.how: One stored Super VL call through Meterless produced drafts for ranks 1 to 3. The Zetaris snapshot reused them after source and policy input equality checks. Remaining rows use computed reasons. Nemotron does not rank; join proposals, local GPU inference, Parse and Content Safety are not demonstrated.

pre_existing.name: Proof Desk (proof.joepro.systems)
pre_existing.what: Joe Gaither's own design-direction tool, built before the hackathon. Used on Oct 21 to produce the Porch Light design brief, direction, dial settings and one background plate. Dev tooling only; no Proof Desk source code is in the product.

pre_existing.name: Design contract and tokens
pre_existing.what: Outputs of Proof Desk: the design contract JSON and CSS custom properties (--pd-* values from Proof Desk's dial-to-CSS formulas).

pre_existing.name: Generated design assets
pre_existing.what: Hero key art, deck plates, OG card, logo mark and hero and logo video loops generated through OpenRouter before the build window. Models, prompts and costs are in the manifest. No people, no third-party marks.

pre_existing.what: engines/*/AGENTS.md specs from github.com/meterless/meterless (Apache-2.0); engines are implemented fresh from them.

pre_existing.name: Zetaris getting-started patterns (open-source reference)
pre_existing.what: Zetaris getting-started patterns (Apache-2.0), credited in NOTICE.

run.setup: README.md Setup, Usage, and Smoke script, plus web/README.md. The committed Manatee call sheet renders without live data credentials. County runs, active alerts, and Storm Watch need local Zetaris, PostGIS, and the files under %USERPROFILE%\.porchlight. Nemotron drafts use the Meterless Nightshift route.

evidence_logs: engines/snapshots/manatee-zetaris.json retains shared query audit evidence and the stored Meterless model execution. Scout Intent decisions and contract events are appended locally to ~/.porchlight/scout-intent/events.jsonl.
